functional_spec:
Implement a synthesizable valid/ready skid buffer pipeline register in SystemVerilog.
Ports:
  input  wire       clk
  input  wire       rst_n
  input  wire       s_valid
  output wire       s_ready
  input  wire [7:0] s_data
  output reg        m_valid
  input  wire       m_ready
  output reg  [7:0] m_data
Behavior:
  Provides a 2-deep skid buffer decoupling upstream s_ready from downstream m_ready (zero combinational path between m_ready and s_ready).
  When downstream is ready (m_ready=1), achieves full 1 beat/cycle throughput.
  When downstream is stalled (m_ready=0), can absorb up to 2 items without losing data before dropping s_ready=0.
  Maintains strict FIFO data ordering.
  Active-low reset rst_n clears valid flags.
expected_behavior: Zero-bubble throughput when ready; buffers stall beats without drop or combinational feedback.
verification_strategy: Cycle simulation with burst data and random backpressure + SBY BMC handshake safety.
sva_code:
module two_phase_handshake_formal(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire s_valid,
    input wire [7:0] s_data,
    input wire m_ready
);
    wire s_ready, m_valid;
    wire [7:0] m_data;

    two_phase_handshake dut (
        .clk(clk),
        .rst_n(rst_n),
        .s_valid(s_valid),
        .s_ready(s_ready),
        .s_data(s_data),
        .m_valid(m_valid),
        .m_ready(m_ready),
        .m_data(m_data)
    );

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst_n) begin
            if ($past(m_valid) && !$past(m_ready)) begin
                assert(m_valid);
                assert(m_data == $past(m_data));
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

Write a synthesizable valid/ready skid buffer pipeline register in SystemVerilog.
Module name: two_phase_handshake
Ports:
  input  wire       clk,
  input  wire       rst_n,
  input  wire       s_valid,
  output wire       s_ready,
  input  wire [7:0] s_data,
  output reg        m_valid,
  input  wire       m_ready,
  output reg  [7:0] m_data
Requirements:
- Skid buffer holding up to 2 elements.
- Cuts combinational path between m_ready and s_ready (registered output).
- Full throughput (1 beat/cycle) when m_ready is high.
- Absorbs beats during downstream stall without data drop or duplication.
Output only SystemVerilog code inside ```systemverilog ... ```.
